name: ArchiveItemInput
description: Represents the input for archiving an item.

inputFields.name: archiveName
inputFields.description: The name of the archive. The default value is 'archive'.

inputFields.name: itemId
inputFields.description: The ID of the item to archive.If both item ID and item path parameters are specified, the item path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: itemPath
inputFields.description: The full path of the item to archive. If both item ID and item path parameters are specified, the item path parameter is ignored.
